# powerhmc_partition_power_on_off (Action)

Action that can perform power on or power off operations for LPAR or VIOS partitions. Supports both LPAR and VIOS partition types with flexible power control options.

Actions are invoked by declaring an `action "powerhmc_partition_power_on_off" "<name>" { config { ... } }` block and triggering it at a resource lifecycle event with a `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` block on that resource. Actions require Terraform v1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Power an LPAR or VIOS partition on or off.

# Power on an AIX/Linux LPAR with a boot mode.
action "powerhmc_partition_power_on_off" "aix_on" {
  config {
    system_name    = "Server-9009-22A-SN123456"
    partition_name = "aix-lpar1"
    partition_type = "lpar" # "lpar" | "vios"
    action         = "poweron"
    boot_mode      = "norm" # "norm" | "dd" | "ds" | "of" | "sms" (AIX/Linux only)
    keylock        = "norm" # "manual" | "norm"
  }
}

# Power on an IBM i (OS400) LPAR. IBM i requires ipl_source and does NOT
# accept boot_mode (the two are mutually exclusive).
action "powerhmc_partition_power_on_off" "ibmi_on" {
  config {
    system_name    = "Server-9009-22A-SN123456"
    partition_name = "ibmi-lpar1"
    partition_type = "lpar"
    action         = "poweron"
    ipl_source     = "a" # "a" | "b" | "c" | "d"
  }
}

# Power off a VIOS partition and restart it.
action "powerhmc_partition_power_on_off" "vios_off" {
  config {
    system_name    = "Server-9009-22A-SN123456"
    partition_name = "vios1"
    partition_type = "vios"
    action         = "poweroff"
    shutdown_mode  = "shutdown" # "shutdown" | "osshutdown" | "dumprestart"
    force_shutdown = true
    restart        = true
    timeout        = 30 # minutes; bounds how long the provider waits (min 1, default 60)
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Power action to perform: `poweron` or `poweroff`
- `partition_name` (String) Name of the partition (LPAR or VIOS)
- `partition_type` (String) Type of partition: `lpar` or `vios`
- `system_name` (String) Name of the managed system as it appears in HMC

### Optional

- `boot_mode` (String) _**PowerOn only**_: Boot mode for AIX/Linux LPARs and VIOS. Valid values: `norm` (default), `dd`, `ds`, `of`, `sms`. Mutually exclusive with `ipl_source`. Not supported for IBM i (OS400) partitions.
- `disable_vsi` (Boolean) _**PowerOn only**_: Disable VSI profile. Defaults to `false`.
- `force_shutdown` (Boolean) _**PowerOff only**_: Force immediate power off without OS shutdown. Defaults to `false`. Cannot be used with `dumprestart` shutdown mode.
- `ipl_source` (String) _**PowerOn only, IBM i (OS400) only**_: IPL source for IBM i partitions. Valid values: `a`, `b`, `c`, `d`. Mutually exclusive with `boot_mode`.
- `keylock` (String) _**PowerOn only**_: Keylock position. Valid values: `manual`, `norm`.
- `profile_name` (String) _**PowerOn only**_: Profile name to use for power on. If not specified, uses the default profile.
- `restart` (Boolean) _**PowerOff only**_: Restart partition after power off. Defaults to `false`. Cannot be used with `osshutdown` or `dumprestart` shutdown modes.
- `shutdown_mode` (String) _**PowerOff only**_: Shutdown mode type. Valid values: `shutdown` (default), `osshutdown`, `dumprestart`.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in minutes for the power operation. Bounds how long the provider waits before cancelling the in-flight operation. Defaults to `60` minutes. Must be at least 1.


## Notes

- PowerOn-only parameters: `boot_mode`, `ipl_source`, `keylock`, `profile_name`, `disable_vsi`.
- PowerOff-only parameters: `shutdown_mode`, `force_shutdown`, `restart`.
- `boot_mode` and `ipl_source` are mutually exclusive.
- IBM i (OS400) LPARs require `ipl_source` and reject `boot_mode`.
- `ipl_source` is only valid when `partition_type = lpar`.
- `restart` cannot combine with `osshutdown` or `dumprestart`.
- `force_shutdown` and `restart` cannot combine with `dumprestart`.
